page.overview:
What is Evil Dead?

Evil Dead (死霊のはらわた Shiryōnoharawata) is a Stand from the 37th universe featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. It is used by Secco Rottario.

Evil Dead is manifested as a giant grimacing head held between two similarly giant hands, with the hands' thumbs buried in the head's eye sockets, as if gouging out its eyes. The hands each have an eye set in the back. The head appears to be bleeding from the eye sockets and mouth, and a jagged scar resembling a runs down its forehead.

Evil Dead's main power is the ability to make a specific location invisible. It was first used when Secco hides Nero Nero Island from the people inside. Though the people outside the island are able to see it.
